assets.name: 木支护运矿枢纽
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: static 16:9 abandoned-mine dungeon route-selection background, environment only. A broad main haulage terrace crosses the center from left to right; parallel upper and lower walkable terraces connect with visible stairs and ramps at several intervals. Six distinct roomy landings along the route. Composition: wide elevated oblique fixed camera, subject walkways readable across x20–88% and y32–80%, quiet dark outer margins for existing game HUD; no gigantic foreground object blocking paths, no tiny vanishing-point paths. Cold-steel dark fantasy realism, PBR worn iron and charcoal rock, restrained warm lamps, blue-gray ambient cave light. No castle, outdoor city, people, zombies, creatures, text, symbols, UI, icons, circles, route overlay, dotted lines, arrows, watermark. Render a full environment, no diagram or collage.
